sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of timeless elegance to your look with these emerald green glass bangles, beautifully adorned with delicate golden dotted detailing. Crafted with a smooth, glossy glass finish, these bangles reflect light gracefully and enhance their rich green hue. Perfectly stacked for a luxurious appearance, they are ideal for festive occasions, weddings, sangeet, mehndi, or traditional daily wear. Pair them with sarees, lehengas, or ethnic suits to elevate your Indian ethnic style effortlessly. A must-have accessory for women who love classic yet elegant jewelry.
